notes: Tailscale add-host: Settings -> Hosts 'Add host' (and the Hosts card) now offers 'Sign in with Tailscale' plus a recovery-code fallback alongside desktop-code pairing; it stores/selects the host profile through the normal encrypted path and leaves onboarding untouched. Safe mode gains a Settings -> Diagnostics entry, dark platform theme, fallback views, a polite live region and TalkBack labels for every recovery action. Also includes 0.2.113 crash-loop safe mode and 0.2.112 Tailscale one-tap sign-in.
